content.comment_body: I've made an [product_name] page that reads several sensors, and I want to keep this data available at all times. Currently, when I refresh the page, I lose my trend view data. Does anyone know how to keep this information stored without needing the page open all the time? Thanks in advance, [user_name]
This isn't possible with the extended web server functionality.

Another option is to use the Data Log function, but it requires downloading the log file and opening it in Excel for graphing. There's also an [product_name] plugin that lets Excel connect to [product_name] and keep the data synced, but you’ll still need the PC online continuously. I hope [company_name] will improve trend view in [product_name] so it can work with log files recorded directly on the MicroSD card inside the device. This would enable displaying longer-term trends on a custom web site.
If you plan to keep your PC on at all times anyway, you can just leave the web server page open 24/7. You can minimize the page, but it has to stay active in the foreground.

If [product_name] could show trend data synchronized with log files stored on a MicroSD card, it wouldn’t be necessary to keep the PC running the Access Tool at all times. Also, trend view or the Access Tool currently only support showing up to 50 recent data points at once.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that trend data shown by [product_name] is lost whenever the page is refreshed, preventing the retention and review of historical data unless the page remains open at all times. Current methods require using external programs or plugins, keeping hardware online, and are limited to a small number of viewable data points, which results in a limited user experience. Users are looking for an integrated solution that preserves and displays persistent trend data and synchronizes the trend view with log files stored locally for easy retrospective analysis.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect trend data in [product_name] to be automatically retained across page refreshes or browser restarts, without needing the web page or PC to remain open constantly.
